items.title: India Crosses Historic Milestone of 1 Crore HPV Vaccine Doses Administered in Less Than Nine Months, Marking Major Progress in Cervical Cancer Prevention
items.summary: The achievement marks a significant step towards protecting adolescent girls against HPV infections that can cause cervical cancer and reflects the growing reach of preventive healthcare services across the country.

facts.text: Launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in February 2026, the nationwide campaign provides free, safe and voluntary single-dose HPV vaccination, with parental consent, to 14-year-old girls at Government health facilities.

The campaign has achieved nearly 87% cumulative coverage against the identified annual target cohort of approximately 1.2 crore girls, based on the Registrar General of India (RGI) 2021 population estimates.

Reaching the 1 crore-dose milestone within nine months underscores the scale and momentum of the initiative, supported by coordinated efforts of States and Union Territories, healthcare professionals, frontline workers, teachers, parents and local communities.

In terms of absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads the country with more than 29.33 lakh 14-year-old girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with over 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with over 7.75 lakh girls vaccinated.

facts.text: The Minister also highlighted the importance of balanced use of pesticides and chemical fertilisers, residue-free agricultural production, climate-resilient farming, indigenous alternatives to imported agricultural products and value addition through food processing.
He also called for greater adoption of natural farming, urging farmers to begin with at least 10 per cent of their cultivated area and gradually expand based on their experience.
The conclave also provided a platform for entrepreneurs, industry representatives, scientists and policymakers to exchange experiences, discuss challenges and explore opportunities for collaboration.

The discussions focused on strengthening the food processing sector, improving product quality, promoting innovation, enhancing export capabilities and ensuring that the benefits of agricultural value addition reach farmers.
